protocol.selection_timing: Locked before completed expanded-SAE stability results
protocol.eligibility: Pass existing SAE recurrence gate; positive activity on >=30 labelled training birds from >=10 genera and >=3 families
protocol.training_rank: Absolute Pearson correlation after subtracting each training family's mean from both activation and trait, over all labelled training birds; exact ties use smaller feature ID
protocol.ordinary_correlations: Reported alongside family-centered correlations without changing ranking
protocol.validation_statistic: Pearson correlation after subtracting each validation family's mean from activation and trait, over all labelled validation birds

bootstrap.unit: Validation genus; sampled with replacement, retaining all constituent species
bootstrap.family_means: Recomputed within each bootstrap sample, including multiplicities
bootstrap.interval: 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles of defined resample correlations

protocol.confirmation: At least1900 defined resamples, interval excludes zero in the training-selected direction, and validation point estimate has that direction
protocol.test_trait_labels: Not used in candidate ranking, validation, confirmation, exemplars or output
protocol.negative_policy: No eligible stable feature or failed validation is retained; no new handpicked candidate
protocol.interpretation: Exploratory association confirmation only: SAE model selection and raw-vector probe used validation data, and raw-probe evidence beyond taxonomy failed

reason: Prespecified validation association did not confirm
